Reference date of the last frost

In the French overseas territories there is no frost: the calendar starts from the beginning of the planting season in your territory. This date is an estimate that varies by 1 to 2 months depending on the source and the microclimate: adjust it to the day. All tasks and sowing reminders are calculated from this day.

In mainland France, the median date falls between mid-March (Mediterranean zone) and mid-May (Ice Saints in lowland / mountain areas). All tasks and sowing reminders are calculated from this reference day.
Above 500 m (e.g. the highlands of La Réunion), the cooler air suits chayote, lettuces and cabbages.
Above 200 m, the last frost date shifts by about 3.5 days for every 100 m.

Enter the passphrase used when exporting.

Off by default. If you turn it on, Android copies your garden to your Google account, encrypted with your phone’s lock code: neither Google nor Sillon can read it. To get it back on another phone, you will need to enter the old phone’s code. Turning this setting off does not delete a copy already sent: delete it from your Google account’s backup. The JSON export above remains the safest way to switch phones.
Unavailable: first set a lock code, pattern or password for your screen. Without it, Android does not encrypt the copy and Sillon does not send it.

Sillon adapts the calendar and the advice depending on whether you grow in open ground, in pots on a balcony or indoors.
Raised beds or garden rows, a calendar based on the last frosts and rotation of plant families.
Growing in pots and planters, a calendar based on frosts with tracking of sun exposure and watering.
Windowsill or grow lamp: sowing is possible all year round, whatever the frosts.
Sillon bases all sowing dates on the average date of the last frosts in your département. Nothing leaves your phone.
A reminder when the time comes?
On Saturday morning, Sillon can tell you which sowings and plantings open in the next two weeks. No message when there is nothing to do.
You can change your mind in Settings.
